findings.highlight: the last rope holding me snap
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の線がぶち切れた
findings.governingReading: The final thread barely holding Shirou together snaps.
findings.explanation: Rope changes the thin final-line image into a materially stronger restraint.

findings.governingReading: The active Japanese ends after Shirou says only that Saber will disappear; the following self-reproach is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates two superseded lines and gives Shirou explicit self-condemnation absent from the active branch.

findings.governingReading: The kneeling narration is commented out in the active Japanese; the page begins with the cost of merely releasing the sword.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores a deleted bodily-position line as active narration.

findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines the strongest imitation, capable of deceiving everyone and even himself.
findings.explanation: Best weakens the repeated 最強 motif from strength to general quality.

findings.highlight: It is not difficult at all.
findings.governingReading: Shirou tells himself that this should not be difficult.
findings.explanation: Not difficult at all converts desperate expectation into categorical ease.

findings.highlight: my left hand feels like it’s on fire
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s whole body burns while his Command Spell hand is specifically crimson flame.
findings.explanation: Feels like it is on fire removes the red-blaze image and reduces the visual intensity of the Command Spell reaction.

findings.highlight: All the blood in me regurgitates.
findings.governingReading: The blood throughout Shirou’s body flows backward.
findings.explanation: Regurgitates assigns a digestive action to blood and produces malformed bodily imagery.

findings.evidenceJa: なんの関心も持ち得ない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot spare the slightest concern for what is happening to his blood.
findings.explanation: No problem denies danger instead of showing his complete indifference to it.

findings.highlight: to really kill me this time
findings.governingReading: Berserker swings to cleave Shirou in two this time.
findings.explanation: Kill removes the concrete impending bisection.

findings.highlight: I’m blocking the attack with the sword in my hand
findings.evidenceJa: 出来かけの剣が見えた
findings.governingReading: Shirou sees the unfinished sword parrying the storm of blows while his conscious attention remains elsewhere.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the defense directly to Shirou and weakens the estranged, nearly automatic bodily action central to the projection state.

findings.governingReading: Emiya Shirou is unsuited to hand-to-hand or martial combat; his battle is inward.
findings.explanation: Fighting broadens the limitation to all forms of conflict, blurring the contrast with his mental battle.

findings.highlight: the attacks I was easily blocking until now
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで防ぎきっていた剣戟
findings.governingReading: Once Shirou’s awareness returns and the sword leaves the action to him, the same sword blows it had been fully warding off fling him away.
findings.explanation: The English says Shirou himself had been easily blocking the attacks and adds ease, reversing the before-and-after agency contrast.

findings.highlight: The senses in my arms are already gone.
findings.governingReading: Shirou has no sensation in the arm wielding the projected sword.
findings.explanation: Arms pluralizes the disabled limb and obscures the direct strain from the weapon-bearing arm.

findings.governingReading: His wrist is red and peeled back, to the point that continued grip seems astonishing.
findings.explanation: The English invents exposed red meat and imminent detachment, then prints a competing milder rewrite.

findings.governingReading: Berserker brings the massive sword down on Shirou.
findings.explanation: The fragment drops the downward trajectory of the finishing strike.

findings.governingReading: Shirou hears her voice closer than anyone else.
findings.explanation: Anything replaces a comparison among people with an indiscriminate comparison to all things.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺を巻き込むように身を返し
findings.governingReading: Saber turns her body as if sweeping Shirou into the motion with her.
findings.explanation: The English breaks off before the shared bodily motion that establishes their joint sword stroke.

findings.governingReading: The golden blade cuts into Berserker’s rock-like body.
findings.explanation: Hard removes the rock material image that echoes the stone sword.

findings.highlight: engulfs the giant’s body from the inside
findings.evidenceJa: 内側から閃光に包み込んだ
findings.governingReading: The embedded golden sword envelops the giant’s body in a flash of light from within.
findings.explanation: The English omits the flash itself, leaving an incomplete account of what engulfs him.

findings.evidenceJa: 刀身から砂となって消えようとしていた
findings.governingReading: The sword begins turning to sand and vanishing from its blade.
findings.explanation: From the tip loses both the sand transformation and the blade as the stated locus.

findings.governingReading: Saber names it the Golden Sword of Assured Victory, with Caliburn supplied as the ruby reading.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only Caliburn and removes the meaning-bearing surface name.

findings.governingReading: Berserker’s chest opens with a gritty, granular impression as the wound begins to crumble like gravel.
findings.explanation: Slowly replaces texture and sound with unsupported speed.

findings.highlight: as if fading into the air
findings.evidenceJa: 白い大気に霞むように
findings.governingReading: Berserker disperses as though growing hazy in the white air.
findings.explanation: The English removes the white atmosphere from his final dissolution image.

findings.governingReading: Saber tells Illya to submit cleanly here, beginning an execution challenge.
findings.explanation: The English ends mid-phrase and leaves Saber’s threat grammatically incomplete.

findings.highlight: I restrain Saber with my hand and quietly call out to her.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを手で止めて、静かに声をかける
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese moves directly from Shirou calling Illya’s name to Illya raising her face; the restraint and notice explanation are commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores two superseded explanatory lines as active narration.

findings.evidenceJa: 糸が切れた人形のように
findings.governingReading: Illya collapses like a puppet whose strings have been cut.
findings.explanation: The English prints two competing similes, including the unsupported image of a doll being switched off.

findings.governingReading: Rin appears to be free because Berserker’s arm has disappeared.
findings.explanation: Finally is printed as a stray competing insertion between two halves of the sentence.
